ForgeAXEffectPluginDefinition.payload: {"kind":"effect-plugin","definition":{"id":"effect.module.magic-cast","name":"魔法原型施法模组 · 模块规则","kind":"attack-module-configuration","scope":"shared-module","description":"魔法训练原型使用的单次施放规则：从具体法术读取形状、命中范围和持续效果，并占用共享施放槽。此原型最多允许1份在场施放，单次目标合法上限为8，实际目标数仍由具体法术决定。它未作为战役默认技能或普通掉落开放。","version":2,"iconGuid":"6a1795e3-ad1b-52e5-8b26-49b2d9cdff0f","families":["module-tuning"],"mechanism":{"kind":"attack-module-configuration","parameters":{"configuration":{},"moduleId":"magic-cast","sourceDomain":{"effectiveUsage":"native-module","modules":[],"boards":[],"ownerChain":["magic-cast"],"purePresentation":false,"ordinaryAvailability":"execution-module-only","moduleEvidence":"assets/packs/abilities/attack-modules/magic-cast.pack.ts","ownerId":"magic-cast"}}},"strength":[{"field":"configuration.maximumActiveCasts","label":"训练原型共享施放容量上限","formula":{"kind":"constant","value":1,"unit":"次施法","levels":{"min":1,"max":1,"kind":"integer"}}},{"field":"configuration.maximumTargets","label":"具体法术允许目标数的上限","formula":{"kind":"constant","value":8,"unit":"个目标","levels":{"min":1,"max":1,"kind":"integer"}}}],"relations":{"defaultWeight":0.05,"familyRules":[],"targetOverrides":[]},"provenance":{"sourcePaths":["assets/packs/content/shared/effects/attack-modules/module.magic-cast/effect.pack.ts","assets/packs/abilities/attack-modules/magic-cast.pack.ts"],"legacyNodeIds":[]},"designNotes":["原生模块继续负责固定步执行；此处只迁移作者参数，不建立效果到模块的反向读取。","所有数值保留作者常量；L1是公式单样本坐标，不新增成长轴。","SpellTrainingCombat可接收原生加载的MagicSpellContent；需要实际装配该原型内容才执行，目录列出模块不代表玩家已经取得魔法技能。","最大在场施放1通过共享施放槽预留检查，命中目标数则由具体魔法定义决定且不得超过8。魔法的形状、范围、区域间隔和伤害不由这两个模块常量代替。","图签用下方单法印、向上释放的箭头和唯一星形法术表示一次施放，不是多段齐射或天赋路径。各训练法术由“执行模块”结构边引用本配置，空概率具名表不表示缺少这些引用；它不把训练原型变成玩家已拥有技能。默认0.05亲和保持，执行结构不提供获取加权。"],"placement":{"contentPackId":"shared","categoryPath":["effects","attack-modules"],"scope":"shared"}}}
